content: Lino u Petro nhu Yohana yevalungumile munyumba imbaha inyimike ija kufunyila unsiki uwa kufunya, mukivalilo kya budika lubale.

Umunhu jumonga, kivwale kuhuma iholua, alyale ipinduaipindua ifighono fioni valyale vikumughonia pamulyango ghwa nyumba imbaha inyimike ijakufunyila ghuno ghukatambulivuagha umuliango unono, ulwakuti akagule kusuma ikitekelo kuhuma kuvanhu Vene kulyalungime kunyimba imbaha inyimike ijakufunyila.
Ya vwene uPetro nhu Yohana valipipi kukwingila munyumba imbaha ijakufunyila, alyasumile ilitekelo.
Petro, akamulunguvalila amaso, palikimo nhu Yohana, akati, “tulolaghe usue.”
Kivwale akavalola, akavahuvilagha kikava kimonga kuhuma kuvanave.
Loli u Petro akajova, “indalama ni sahabu une nanilinafyo, loli kinonilinakyo nihumia kulyuve. Mhu litavua ilya Yes kilisite ughwa mhu Nazareth, ghendagha.”
U Petro akantola nhi kivoko kya mwene ikyandio, akamwinamula munkyanya: nakalingi amaghulu gha mwene nififughamilo fya mwene ni fijeghe fikapata ingufu.
Akajumba mukyanya, umunhu kivwale pe akima pe akatengula kughenda, akingila munyumba imbaha inyimike ijakufunyila palikimo nhu Petro nhu Yohana, akaghenda, akajumba, napikumongesia u NGuluve.
Avanhu vooni vakambwene ighenda na pikumughinia uNguluve.
Vakakagulu Kati ghwe jula juno alyale ikukala na kusuma ilitekelo pa muliango unono ughwa nyumba inyimike ijakufunyila; valyamemile kudegha name kudegha kyongo pakila kinokikahumile Kwa mwene.
Ndavule alyavakolelile uPetro nhu Yohana, avanhuavanhu voni vakakimbiliila muvukumbi vuno vatambulagha Sulemani, vakadeghagha kyingo.

U Petro Jeff alivwene iili, umwene akavamula avaanhu, “umue mwevanhu va much Israeli, kicking mudegha? Nakiki mulangamile amaso ghinu kulyusie, hence twesue tubombile uju ulwakuti aghendaghe ni ngufu siitu nhu vwitiki vwitu?

U Nguleve ghwa Ibrahim, nhu ghwa Isaka, nhu ghwa Yakobo, Nguluve ghwa Va Nhataa viitu, amwimike um'bombi ghwa mwene u Yesu. uju ghwe mwene Juno umue mukafumbatisie na panoramic umwene alyale ilonda kumulekesia ave mwavuke.
Mulyakanile umwike kange unyavwakang'ani, niki umue mukamolonda um'budighwe alekue ave mwavuke.
Umue mulya m'budile untua ughwa vuumi, Juno u NgeluveNgeluve aliyah syusisie kuhuma ku vafue use tulivolesi va iliio.
Lino mulwitiko mulitavua lya mwene, umunhu uju Juno mukam'bona napikagula, alyimikiluue kuvomba ningufu. Ulwitiko luno lukililakwa Yesu uvulamuke uvupesie, pavulongolo palyumue mwevoni.
Lino, vanyalukolo, nikaguile kuti mulyavombile mhuvujasu, pe valyavombile vulevule avalongosi vinhu.
Loli amasio ghino uNguluve aliyah vavulile nga'aani kukilila mumalomo agha vaviilivaviili voni, Katie ujuuju kilisite ilipumuka lino akwisisie.
Lino, mulataghe, musyetuke, ulwakuti uvuhosi vwinu vuoni vuvusivie, ulwakuti ghuise unsiki ughwa kutengana vwimila nhu vutavulivua.
Mulwakuti akagule pikumwomola kilisite Juno asalulivue vwimila umue, Yesu.
Ujuo ghwe mwene uvulanga vumhupilile pano filava figomoka ifinhu fioni, silo u Nguluve alyasijovile pakali kukila mumalomo gha vaviili.
Sakyang'ani u Musa alyajovile, u Mutwa unguluve ikumwimiagha um'bili ndavule uneasy kuhuma munkate muvanyalukolo vitu. Mulikumpulikisyagha ifinhu fyoni fine ikuvavula umue.
Lulihumila kuuti umunhu ghueni Juno naipulika Kwan m'biili ujuo ghwe itipulivuagha avuke pakate pa vannhu.
Ena, navavili voni kutengulila uSamweli navano valisile pambele pa mwene valyajovile kange vakapulisia ifighono ifi.
Umwe mhu livana vavvili kange valufingo luno uNguluve alyafingine palikimo nava nyenya, ndavule alyajovile Kwan Abrahimu, 'Mhu mbeju Jakob ing'olo sooni isa mhu iisi sifunyuagha.
U Nguluve ya mwimisiemwimisie umbombi ghwake, alyamwomwile kulyumue tasi, ulwakuti avafunye umue ulwakushetuka kuhuma muvuhosi vwinhu.
